title: Trustworthy Endoscopic Super-Resolution
summary: Super-resolution (SR) models are attracting growing interest for enhancing minimally invasive surgery and diagnostic videos under hardware constraints. However, valid concerns remain regarding the introduction of hallucinated structures and amplified noise, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings. We propose a direct and practical framework to make SR systems more trustworthy by identifying where reconstructions are likely to fail. Our approach integrates a lightweight error-prediction network that operates on intermediate representations to estimate pixel-wise reconstruction error. The module is computationally efficient and low-latency, making it suitable for real-time deployment. We convert these predictions into operational failure decisions by constructing Conformal Failure Masks (CFM), which localize regions where the SR output should not be trusted. Built on conformal risk control principles, our method provides theoretical guarantees for controlling both the tolerated error limit and the miscoverage in detected failures. We evaluate our approach on image and video SR, demonstrating its effectiveness in detecting unreliable reconstructions in endoscopic and robotic surgery settings. To our knowledge, this is the first study to provide a model-agnostic, theoretically grounded approach to improving the safety of real-time endoscopic image SR.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework to make endoscopic super-resolution systems trustworthy by using a lightweight error-prediction network to estimate pixel-wise reconstruction errors and generating Conformal Failure Masks (CFM) to localize untrustworthy regions, with theoretical guarantees from conformal risk control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个框架，通过使用轻量级误差预测网络估计像素级重建误差，并生成一致性失败掩模(CFM)来定位不可信区域，从而使内镜超分辨率系统更加可信，并具有来自一致性风险控制的理论保证。
summary_zh: 超分辨率（SR）模型在硬件限制下增强微创手术和诊断视频方面越来越引起关注。然而，人们对其可能引入幻觉结构并放大噪声的担忧依然存在，这限制了其在安全关键场景中的可靠性。我们提出了一个直接且实用的框架，通过识别重建可能失败的位置来提高SR系统的可信度。我们的方法集成了一个轻量级误差预测网络，该网络在中间表示上运行，以估计逐像素的重建误差。该模块计算效率高且延迟低，适合实时部署。我们通过构建共形失败掩膜（CFM）将这些预测转换为操作失败决策，从而定位不应信任SR输出的区域。基于共形风险控制原则，我们的方法为控制容错限值和检测失败中的错误覆盖率提供了理论保证。我们在图像和视频SR上评估了我们的方法，展示了其在内镜和机器人手术场景中检测不可靠重建的有效性。据我们所知，这是首次提供一种与模型无关的、有理论基础的提高实时内镜图像SR安全性的方法。

title: Locomotion of an Elastic Snake Robot via Natural Dynamics
summary: Nature suggests that exploiting the elasticities and natural dynamics of robotic systems could increase their locomotion efficiency. Prior work on elastic snake robots supports this hypothesis, but has not fully exploited the nonlinear dynamic behavior of the systems. Recent advances in eigenmanifold theory enable a better characterization of the natural dynamics in complex nonlinear systems. This letter investigates if and how the nonlinear natural dynamics of a kinematic elastic snake robot can be used to design efficient gaits. Two types of gaits based on natural dynamics are presented and compared to a state-of-the-art approach using dynamics simulations. The results reveal that a gait generated by switching between two nonlinear normal modes does not improve the locomotion efficiency of the robot. In contrast, gaits based on non-brake periodic trajectories (non-brake orbits) are perfectly efficient in the energy-conservative case. Further simulations with friction reveal that, in a more realistic scenario, non-brake orbit gaits achieve higher efficiency compared to the baseline gait on the rigid system. Overall, the investigation offers promising insights into the design of gaits based on natural dynamics, fostering further research.
tldr: The paper explores using the nonlinear natural dynamics of an elastic snake robot to design energy‑efficient gaits, finding that non‑brake periodic trajectories outperform switching between nonlinear normal modes and a baseline rigid approach.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了利用弹性蛇形机器人的非线性固有动力学来设计节能步态，发现非制动周期轨迹在能效上优于切换非线性正则模态及刚性基准步态。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自然界表明，利用机器人系统的弹性和固有动力学可以提高其运动效率。之前关于弹性蛇形机器人的研究支持这一假设，但尚未完全挖掘系统的非线性动态行为。本征流形理论的最新进展能够更好地表征复杂非线性系统中的固有动力学。本文研究运动弹性蛇形机器人的非线性固有动力学是否可以以及如何用于设计高效步态。提出了两种基于固有动力的步态，并通过动力学仿真与现有先进方法进行了比较。结果表明，在两种非线性正规模态之间切换产生的步态并不能提高机器人的运动效率。相反，基于非制动周期轨迹（非制动轨道）的步态在能量守恒情况下非常高效。进一步的摩擦仿真表明，在更现实的场景中，非制动轨道步态与刚性系统的基准步态相比具有更高的效率。总体而言，该研究为基于固有动力学设计步态提供了有价值的见解，并促进了进一步的研究。

title: Sharpening Lightweight Models for Generalized Polyp Segmentation: A Boundary Guided Distillation from Foundation Models
summary: Automated polyp segmentation is critical for early colorectal cancer detection and its prevention, yet remains challenging due to weak boundaries, large appearance variations, and limited annotated data. Lightweight segmentation models such as U-Net, U-Net++, and PraNet offer practical efficiency for clinical deployment but struggle to capture the rich semantic and structural cues required for accurate delineation of complex polyp regions. In contrast, large Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), including SAM, OneFormer, Mask2Former, and DINOv2, exhibit strong generalization but transfer poorly to polyp segmentation due to domain mismatch, insufficient boundary sensitivity, and high computational cost. To bridge this gap, we propose \textit{\textbf{LiteBounD}, a \underline{Li}gh\underline{t}w\underline{e}ight \underline{Boun}dary-guided \underline{D}istillation} framework that transfers complementary semantic and structural priors from multiple VFMs into compact segmentation backbones. LiteBounD introduces (i) a dual-path distillation mechanism that disentangles semantic and boundary-aware representations, (ii) a frequency-aware alignment strategy that supervises low-frequency global semantics and high-frequency boundary details separately, and (iii) a boundary-aware decoder that fuses multi-scale encoder features with distilled semantically rich boundary information for precise segmentation. Extensive experiments on both seen (Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicDB) and unseen (ColonDB, CVC-300, ETIS) datasets demonstrate that LiteBounD consistently outperforms its lightweight baselines by a significant margin and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining the efficiency required for real-time clinical use. Our code is available at https://github.com/lostinrepo/LiteBounD.
tldr: We propose LiteBounD, a lightweight boundary‑guided distillation framework that extracts semantic and boundary knowledge from large vision foundation models and transfers it to compact polyp segmentation networks, achieving state‑of‑the‑art accuracy while preserving real‑time clinical efficiency.
tldr_zh: 我们提出了LiteBounD，一个轻量级的边界引导蒸馏框架，将大型视觉基础模型的语义和边界知识迁移到紧凑的结肠息肉分割网络中，在保持实时临床效率的同时实现了先进的分割精度。
summary_zh:
摘要：
自动息肉分割对早期结直肠癌检测及其预防至关重要，但由于边界模糊、外观差异大以及标注数据有限等因素，该任务仍然具有挑战性。U-Net、U-Net++和PraNet等轻量级分割模型在临床部署中具有实用效率优势，但难以捕捉精确勾勒复杂息肉区域所需的丰富语义和结构线索。相比之下，大型视觉基础模型（VFMs），包括SAM、OneFormer、Mask2Former和DINOv2，表现出较强的泛化能力，但由于领域不匹配、边界敏感性不足以及计算成本高等问题，难以有效迁移到息肉分割任务。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了LiteBounD（轻量级边界引导蒸馏框架），该框架将多个视觉基础模型的互补语义和结构先验知识迁移到紧凑的分割主干网络中。LiteBounD引入了（i）双路径蒸馏机制，用于解耦语义和边界感知表示；（ii）频率感知对齐策略，分别监督低频全局语义和高频边界细节；（iii）边界感知解码器，将多尺度编码器特征与蒸馏的语义丰富边界信息融合，以实现精确分割。在可见数据集（Kvasir-SEG、CVC-ClinicDB）和不可见数据集（ColonDB、CVC-300、ETIS）上的大量实验表明，LiteBounD始终以显著优势超越其轻量级基线方法，并达到与最先进方法相当的性能，同时保持了实时临床使用所需的效率。我们的代码可访问 https://github.com/lostinrepo/LiteBounD。
